title: Exclude fixed-clock Type B odd/even idle fusions (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On exact signed #7113, fuse one singleton odd Type B idle with one disjoint-mask even idle. Keep the old odd clock, role and q inverse factor, with all other events fixed. The exact necessary q = +1 unit-body projector gate excludes all 180 pairs. Each has a nonzero off-axis transported column. Every independent rational witness reduces to the primary modular value, and zero keys remain unresolved. The higher signed and physical gates were unnecessary.

The complete predecode price grants one removed paid child per Type B port. The largest one-edit gross credit is 0.7850445440362529 raw. The disjoint weighted matching upper is 3.076075380146476 raw before ancillary costs. The verified saving in the tested family is zero. #7315 treats even/even fusion and #7296 addresses one included pair under a different packed physical model.

## Replay

Exact #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace`, κ `0.00364665195644`, and exact signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. Use CPython 3.12 from a clean checkout:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-type-b-odd-even-idle-bound/replay.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-type-b-odd-even-idle-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-type-b-odd-even-idle-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
```

Local registered, committed source/mode, navigation and official Git-free checks passed. The replay reconstructs the whole price, checks both exact witnesses on all keys, and rejects altered caller bytes. The branch carries #7257's exact shared planner repair.

## Credit and next question

#7113 and #7334 supply the caller and comparator. #7298 supplies the directed tariff, #7315 the transported-projector method, #7296 the overlapping one-pair physical limit, and #7323 and #7356 the fixed-clock phase-transfer comparisons. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted. A changed host or multiple-role replacement needs its own signed interface and price.
